selection: latest provider publishDate whose China next-day midnight is no later than September 1; tie: lexicographically smallest infoCode; no rating/title/performance filter; no older-report fallback after PDF validation failure
pdf_eligibility: printed date and provider date both available by cutoff under next-day date proxy; three absolute FY forecast columns starting origin year; explicit revenue label and unit; discrepancies retained as rejection

comparison_plan.benchmark: known origin H1 revenue plus prior H2 revenue; flat thereafter
comparison_plan.current_rule: known origin H1 revenue + prior H2 revenue*(1+frozen origin clipped growth); subsequent FY multiply by same growth
comparison_plan.actual: sum four TDX FN230 quarters for each target FY; future FY remains unobservable
comparison_plan.decision: single-company exposed-source diagnostic only; no policy adoption or claim of market consensus or full DCF accuracy

boundary: one latest broker report is not consensus; later-acquired date proxy not strict PIT; two exposed companies not independent validation; no production adoption based on pilot average; retain all six company/origin positions and missing forecasts
